name: Hiraya (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Hiraya village emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised character of angular strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Hiraya, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Hiraya village emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised character of angular strokes
